description: DEV-2832: place a per-person hold on ONE to-do item for the named contracts and/or proposals. While the hold is ACTIVE, every assignment of that item created for each named person — a manual assign or the hire-time future-hire auto-assignment — is born SCHEDULED: worker-invisible, no due/blocking schedule, no notification, provider-dormant. It opens only when the hold is released: by opentrain_release_project_todo_hold, by the audited opentrain_activate_project_todo override, or AUTOMATICALLY once the optional releaseRule is satisfied for that person (e.g. {"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"ALL","predicates":[{"kind":"todo_completed","itemId":"<LMS course to-do item id>"}]} — the LMS to-do completes only from the system-verified PASS; WAIVED does not count under the default COMPLETED_ONLY). A hold NEVER changes anyone else’s obligations, never re-locks an already-activated assignment (preview first: ALREADY_ACTIVE), and is one ACTIVE hold per item and person (placing again converges as ALREADY_HELD). Use it BEFORE the hire to beat the hire-time auto-assignment race. Requires project_todos:write, a required audited reason, and a stable idempotencyKey (same key + same payload replays; a different payload is a 409).

idempotencyKey.description: Client idempotency key; deterministic retries converge.

reason.description: Required audited reason (e.g. "Feather practice only after LMS PASS").

anyOf.description: Optional automatic release condition in the activation-rule shape, e.g. release after the LMS course to-do COMPLETED (system-verified PASS): {"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"ALL","predicates":[{"kind":"todo_completed","itemId":"<LMS course to-do item id>"}]}. Omit or null = manual release only.

releaseRule.description: Optional automatic release condition in the activation-rule shape, e.g. release after the LMS course to-do COMPLETED (system-verified PASS): {"schemaVersion":1,"mode":"ALL","predicates":[{"kind":"todo_completed","itemId":"<LMS course to-do item id>"}]}. Omit or null = manual release only.

subjects.description: The PEOPLE the hold names: contractIds and/or proposalIds of the job (at least one id, at most 100 in total).

contractIds.description: Active contracts of the job (hired people).

proposalIds.description: Proposals of the job whose candidate is not hired yet; the hold then binds the hire-time auto-assignment.

name: opentrain_hold_project_todo
